title: pcbflow: a personal attempt at LLM for EDA (final archive)
description:
Solo research project (Sep–Oct 2026) asking where a large language model actually helps in a PCB routing pipeline. Contains a from-scratch deterministic router (V5 engine), a seven-stage KiCad design-flow compiler, an STM32H743 4-layer SoM core board (not fabricated; production_signoff_ready=false) and six Chinese technical reports covering about one hundred pre-registered experiment batches.

Main finding: the LLM was most useful as an evaluator of routing results (reading structured verdict data and attributing failures); almost every other role produced negative or null results under matched controls. Negative results are published on purpose.

Third-party corpus boards are not redistributed; see tools/pcbflow/datasets-manifests/SOURCES.json.
